channel.title: Late Brake blog
channel.description: Formula 1 news, history, fun facts and what happened on this day.

item.title: On this day: Massa's farewell and Verstappen's record 19th win
item.description: Bottas won Felipe Massa's final F1 race in Abu Dhabi in 2017, and six years later Max Verstappen closed a record season at the same circuit.

item.title: FIA finds Williams broke F1's 2025 cost cap by £627,000
item.description: Williams overspent F1's 2025 budget cap by 0.48% and loses some wind tunnel time, while Alpine is fined for a reporting breach.

item.title: Six F1 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix facts that sound made up
item.description: A hotel over the track, a pit exit through a tunnel and a champion who led for the first time at the flag: six true facts about F1 in Abu Dhabi.

item.title: How Vettel won the 2008 Italian Grand Prix in a Toro Rosso
item.description: Aged 21, Sebastian Vettel took pole and won a wet Monza race for the team that had been Minardi, becoming F1's youngest winner at the time.

item.title: On this day: Schumacher's last race and Alonso's farewell
item.description: On 25 November Michael Schumacher raced for the last time at Interlagos in 2012, and Fernando Alonso and Kimi Räikkönen said goodbye in Abu Dhabi in 2018.

item.title: Gasly says cooling problem cost him an F1 Las Vegas podium
item.description: Pierre Gasly finished fifth in Las Vegas but says his Alpine ran with reduced power for 45 laps because the car was overheating.

item.title: How Häkkinen passed Schumacher around Zonta at Spa in 2000
item.description: Mika Häkkinen won the 2000 Belgian Grand Prix with one of F1's most famous overtakes, using a lapped BAR to get past Michael Schumacher.

item.title: How Karun Chandhok became India's second F1 driver
item.description: From Formula Maruti in Chennai to a last-minute seat at a brand new team, this is how Karun Chandhok reached F1 in 2010, and what came after.

item.title: F1 Qatar Grand Prix 2026: race time in India and full schedule
item.description: The F1 Qatar Grand Prix starts at 9:30pm India time on Sunday 29 November. Here is every session of the Lusail weekend in India time.

item.title: Herta ends F2 season early as Bilinski takes his Hitech seat
item.description: Cadillac's F1 reserve driver Colton Herta will miss the last two F2 rounds in Qatar and Abu Dhabi, with Roman Bilinski stepping in at Hitech.

item.title: Six F1 Qatar Grand Prix facts that sound made up
item.description: A stand-in first race, a year off for the football World Cup and a title won on a Saturday: six true stories from F1's visits to Lusail.

item.title: Camara to finish F1 season with Haas, giving up F2 title bid
item.description: Haas will keep Rafael Camara for Qatar and Abu Dhabi, ending the Brazilian's chance to win the Formula 2 title he currently leads by seven points.

item.title: On this day: Hamilton's double-points title and Russell's Vegas win
item.description: On 23 November Lewis Hamilton won his second F1 title in Abu Dhabi in 2014, and George Russell won in Las Vegas as Max Verstappen clinched his fourth in 2024.

item.title: Verstappen wins F1 Las Vegas GP as Ferrari drivers collide
item.description: Max Verstappen held off both McLarens to win in Las Vegas, while Russell hit the wall late on and Leclerc was penalised for spinning Hamilton.

item.title: How Senna nearly won the 1984 Monaco Grand Prix in a Toleman
item.description: In the rain at Monaco in 1984, rookie Ayrton Senna charged from 13th in an unfancied Toleman and was catching the leader when the race was stopped.

item.title: Pirelli limits F1 drivers to 27 laps per set of tyres in Qatar
item.description: Pirelli will cap every set of tyres at 27 laps at next weekend's F1 Qatar Grand Prix, forcing at least two pit stops in the 57-lap race.

item.title: On this day: Kubica's F1 comeback and Verstappen's Vegas win
item.description: On 22 November, Williams confirmed Robert Kubica's return to F1 eight years after his rally crash, and Verstappen won in Las Vegas as both McLarens were disqualified.

item.title: Verstappen on F1 Las Vegas pole as Antonelli takes grid penalty
item.description: Kimi Antonelli was fastest in Las Vegas qualifying, but a five-place grid penalty hands pole to Max Verstappen, with George Russell alongside him.

item.title: Six F1 engine facts that sound made up, but are true
item.description: A 16-cylinder winner, a road car engine that made a champion and a team that never started a race: six true stories from F1 engine history.

item.title: F1 agrees to bring back V8 engines from 2030
item.description: The FIA says F1 and every engine maker have agreed on a 2.1-litre turbocharged V8 with a smaller hybrid part, a year earlier than the next rules were due.

item.title: On this day: Laffite is born and Hamilton wins Qatar's first race
item.description: On 21 November Jacques Laffite, Ligier's most successful driver, was born in 1943, and in 2021 Lewis Hamilton won the first Qatar Grand Prix.

item.title: Russell fastest in wet F1 Las Vegas practice as FP1 washes out
item.description: George Russell beat Alpine's Pierre Gasly by 0.071 seconds in a wet second practice in Las Vegas after rain left the first session without a single lap time.

item.title: How Piquet won the 1981 F1 title by one point in Las Vegas
item.description: Nelson Piquet arrived at the 1981 Caesars Palace Grand Prix a point behind Carlos Reutemann and left as champion, too exhausted to stand.

item.title: F1 to show drivers' heart rates on TV as Verstappen opts out
item.description: F1 has signed WHOOP to put drivers' heart-rate data on live broadcasts from 2027, but Max Verstappen says he will not take part.

item.title: On this day: Moss wins at Riverside and Vettel bows out in Abu Dhabi
item.description: On 20 November Stirling Moss won the 1960 United States Grand Prix from pole, and in 2022 Sebastian Vettel scored a point in his final F1 race.

item.title: FIA to bring in full-time F1 stewards from 2027
item.description: The FIA will hire its first full-time F1 stewards in 2027 and build to a group of 12 to 15, in a bid to make race decisions more consistent.

item.title: Six F1 facts about American teams that sound made up
item.description: A beard lost on a bet, a win a week after Le Mans, two different Haas teams and a team that never turned a wheel: six true stories of American F1 teams.

item.title: Piastri to take 10-place grid penalty at F1 Las Vegas GP
item.description: McLaren's Oscar Piastri will drop 10 places on the Las Vegas grid after needing a fifth engine of the 2026 season following a reliability problem.

item.title: On this day: Adams and Lotterer, Spa's one-off F1 drivers, born
item.description: Two drivers born on 19 November made brief F1 appearances at Spa: Belgium's Philippe Adams in 1994 and Le Mans winner André Lotterer in 2014.

item.title: Bottas keeps his Cadillac F1 seat for 2027 ahead of Herta
item.description: Cadillac will keep Valtteri Bottas alongside Sergio Perez in 2027, choosing him over test driver Colton Herta and completing next year's F1 grid.
